name: growthnation
description: Two self-contained social-proof skills for B2B sales. Proof Audit (/proof-audit) scores how fresh a company's testimonials, case studies and reviews are and tells you what to refresh. Proof Meeting Prep (/proof-meeting-prep) reads every person in a sales call and hands back the one proof angle that lands for each. Both use only built-in web search + fetch — no API keys, no server, no login.
